headline: Enhance ClearInstall with Real-Time Dependency Analysis
summary: Integrate real-time dependency analysis to detect potential security risks and compatibility issues early in the development process, ensuring a safer and more efficient installation experience. Implement AI-driven insights for better decision-making during package installations.
actions: Add real-time vulnerability scanning to identify known security threats before installation.
Implement automated compatibility checks between dependencies to prevent runtime errors.
Integrate machine learning models to predict potential issues based on historical data and user feedback.
